label: tampered
instruction: Examine this identity document image. Is it authentic or has it been tampered with? If tampered, describe what was altered and where.
target_text: TAMPERED. A region of the image was duplicated from elsewhere in the same document and pasted over the target area (copy-move forgery), likely altering a numeric or text field. Approximate location (normalized bbox): [0.05, 0.725, 0.1641, 1.0].
